usedFor: ZenCommerce holds store orders, and “New Order Created” saves the buyer in Google Contacts.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in ZenCommerce, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each new buyer is saved as a contact, so your address book grows with your orders.

watchOut: “Add Contact to Group” in Google Contacts finds an existing contact, so run “Create Contact” first for new buyers.
